name: Card Payment Transaction Details 8
definition: Details of the transaction in the authorisation request.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amounts associated with the total amount of transaction.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Data related to an integrated circuit card application.

PaymentContext.name: Payment Context
PaymentContext.definition: Context of the card payment transaction.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.

TransactionDateTime.name: Transaction Date Time
TransactionDateTime.definition: Local date and time of the transaction assigned by the POI (Point Of Interaction).

SaleReferenceNumber.name: Sale Reference Number
SaleReferenceNumber.definition: Identification of a sale transaction assigned by the sale system.

RePresentmentReason.name: Re Presentment Reason
RePresentmentReason.definition: Reason for representment of a card transaction.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service in addition to the main service.

TransactionReference.name: Transaction Reference
TransactionReference.definition: Identification of the transaction that has to be unique for a time period.
